breadcrumb.name: Sika AnchorFix® Hole Cleaning Brushes Steel

tagline: Sika AnchorFix® tool to clean drill holes
summary: Sika AnchorFix® Hole Cleaning Brushes Steel is a brush to clean drill hole sizes of Ø12mm to Ø55mm for Sika AnchorFix® applications.
metaDescription: Sika AnchorFix® Hole Cleaning Brushes Steel is a brush to clean drill hole sizes of Ø12mm to Ø55mm for Sika AnchorFix® applications.
attributes: Different diameters for all sizes of drill holes
Additional accessories available to extend the handle length
usage: Manual drill hole cleaning used in combination with the Sika cleaning pump or compressed air
advantages: Different diameters for all sizes of drill holes
Additional accessories available to extend the handle length
packaging: Bag of 1 piece per brush size (Head + extension + handle)

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: Full steel brushes are referenced in the corresponding approvals of each Sika AnchorFix® product

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures. Always refer to packaging.
